text.p: Incyte Pharmaceuticals Inc and Abbott Laboratories Inc said Monday they expanded their database agreement, originally signed in December 1995.
The expanded agreement provides Abbott with access to Incyte's PathoSeq microbial database and LifeSeq FL database of full-length genes.
Abbott continues to have access to Incyte's LifeSeq human sequence and expression database and custom satellite services provided in the original agreement.

The agreement provides for the payment of yearly subscription fees, on-site access fees, and satellite database fees, the companies said. In addition, Incyte could receive royalties on sales of products developed with Incyte technology and database information.
Incyte designs, develops and markets of genomic database products, software tools, and related services.
Abbott develops, makes and markets pharmaceutical, diagnostic, nutritional and hospital products.
